title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - NetPointReference
description: Net Point Reference (era:NetPointReference's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Represents a point reference in the network. Inherits attributes from era:NetBasicReference/era:Feature (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'NetPointReference'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

appliesToDirection.description: Property. The direction relative to the origin of the linear element towards the point reference applies. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Directions of the orientation of a railway element' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/orientations/OrientationDirections), 3 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

hasLrsCoordinate.description: Relationship. Specifies the LRS coordinate associated with a topological coordinate.

hasTopoCoordinate.description: Relationship. Specifies the topological coordinate of a network point reference.

validity.description: Relationship. Relates a feature with a temporal feature to indicate a validity period. Target type (TemporalFeature) is not published as its own SDM model in this RINF pass.
